entities.name: Grolnok
entities.description: A massive frog worshiped as a deity in Nephalia, Innistrad.

entities.name: Spawn of Grolnok
entities.description: Nephalian cult that raised a frog as the one true Grolnok.

entities.name: Temple of Toxrill
entities.description: Rival Nephalian cult that obtained its own monster.

entities.name: Gitrog monster
entities.description: Monster whose egg the Spawn of Grolnok believed they obtained.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad where the cults rival each other.

events.summary: The Spawn of Grolnok perform a ritual on an egg said to be the Gitrog monster's, hatching a humongous frog they call the true Grolnok.
events.quote: They cast an arcane ritual on the egg

events.summary: Hearing the temple has its own monster, the spawn prepare for their final battle.
events.quote: the spawn began preparations for their final battle

relations.quote: There is no more bitter a rivalry among Nephalia 's cults than that between the Spawn of Grolnok and the Temple of Toxrill
Declaring this monster the one true Grolnok
